review.imagery: 44 gallery entries include 8 dated site photographs. All 32 primary assets, the complete 58-page brochure index, seven native resources and eight September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. One exact primary repeat, a native texture and repeated living crop were excluded. Five brochure scenes add lobby, lift, bedroom and gym details. Some official interiors also appear in other Cove marketing and retain shared-design concept scope. The complete building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All six full original physical sheets 2–7 were visually reviewed on two contacts. The grouped levels and separate 3 BR category on floors 8–17 remain intact. One openly displayed studio image was viewed at native size and has no numerical area. Two further broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. No aggregate unit-category range was assigned to this preview. Six complete building sheets and one attributed broker studio preview are available. The original level packet groups residential floors and retains its colour legends. No numerical individual saleable area is printed. Confirm final home areas and revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure page 15 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Individual times follow its actual printed schedule. Camera-centre numbers from the named-place embed were excluded. No explicit target coordinate pair is published there.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochures and drawings retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly mirror attribution. Public home previews retain their observed open-figure URLs. Full source bytes, notices and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, contractual studio matching, remaining form-gated broker layouts, exact visitor entrance, current certified site progress, final specifications and guaranteed surrounding views remain unavailable or unverified.
